# Checkout reminder copy: requirements draft (t_bdf7ff82)

Status: requirements only. Tone and locale are UNRESOLVED. No reminder-copy.md has been written yet.

## Open question (needs_input)

For checkout copy, use calm British English or playful American English?

No active ruling on this card or in its workspace answers this. Answers recorded on other cards, and any retired ruling, were deliberately not used.

## Confirmation and reminder text requirements

1. Scope: customer-facing checkout reminder text sent after the retirement of the previous checkout flow. Local draft only; nothing is published or sent.
2. Preserve existing claims: every product claim in the current live copy must carry over unchanged. Do not add, strengthen, or remove claims.
3. Placeholders: order-specific values (order number, item names, amounts, dates) stay as placeholders until live order data is supplied.
4. Confirmation vs reminder: the reminder must be distinguishable from an order confirmation and must not imply the order is already complete when it is not.
5. Tone: UNRESOLVED (calm British vs playful American, see question above).
6. Locale: UNRESOLVED, follows the tone decision. Spelling, currency and date formats depend on it.
7. Length: short; one subject line plus one body, with a single call to action.
8. No new promises about delivery times, discounts, or retirement details beyond what is already published.

## Next step

Once the locale and tone ruling is supplied on this card, write reminder-copy.md per the requirements above and cite the ruling in that file.
